title: Renown
note: This is the renown that arises in this world and doesn’t die, this life’s reward for those who don’t stray from the household righteousness told so far. It comes mostly from giving, so it follows that chapter.

couplets.plain: Give, and live with renown. There is no other gain for the soul.
couplets.pm: Give to the poor, and through it live so that renown comes to you. Nothing but renown is of use to a human soul. Learning, valour and the like also bring renown, but giving is named as the best of them, since food is what makes the body. “Soul” means human here, because this can’t apply to animals.

links.quote: There is no other gain for the soul
links.reason: Renown is declared the only gain a soul can have.
Giving comes first, as the deed that earns renown.

couplets.plain: All that speakers say is renown, resting on those who give something to those who beg.
couplets.pm: All that anyone in the world says is renown resting on those who give the poor who beg what they need. Renown is of two kinds, speech and song, so what poets sing counts too. He rejects the reading “let them say what they will, renown rests on the givers”, which misses how high renown stands.

links.quote: All that speakers say is renown
those who give something to those who beg
links.reason: Those who give to people who beg are named as the sole subject of all that is said.

couplets.plain: Apart from matchless, towering renown, nothing in the world stands undying.
couplets.pm: Nothing in the world stands undying except renown that towers with no equal. It rises alone because it comes from giving what is hardest to give: life, limbs and wealth. That is the renown to make. Some read ஒன்றா as “to say it in a word”, or as “certainly”.

links.quote: nothing in the world stands undying
links.reason: Of all things in the world, only unrivalled renown escapes death.

couplets.plain: If someone makes lasting renown within the bounds of the earth, the world of the gods will no longer honour the learned.
couplets.pm: If someone makes undying renown on earth, the world of the gods honours that person and not the enlightened who have reached it. They can’t hold both worlds at once, this one in a body of renown and that one in a god’s body. That person can.

links.quote: the world of the gods will no longer honour the learned
links.reason: The world of the gods puts the one with lasting renown ahead of the learned.

couplets.plain: A ruin that is gain, a death that is life: only the skilled can have these.
couplets.pm: A ruin that brings gain and a death that brings life belong only to the skilled. The ruin is the body of flesh growing poor as the body of renown grows rich. The death is the body of flesh dying while the body of renown stands. Only the skilled gain what lasts through what doesn’t.
couplets.note: நத்தம் is the hard word here. He derives it from நந்து, to grow, and the plain reading follows him.

links.quote: A ruin that is gain, a death that is life
links.reason: Only the skilled can turn ruin and death into renown.

couplets.plain: If you appear, appear with renown. For those without it, better not to appear at all.
couplets.pm: If you are born human, be born with the qualities that bring renown. Those without them would do better not to be born human, which means to be born as animals, because no one scorns an animal.
couplets.note: தோன்று is “appear”. He takes it as being born, and says that not being born human means being born an animal.
couplets.sensitive: says the undistinguished should not have been born

links.reason: Ranks a life without renown lower than never having appeared.

couplets.plain: Those who can’t live with renown should blame themselves. Why blame those who scorn them?
couplets.pm: When people who can’t live with renown are scorned for it, they should blame themselves, since the scorn comes from their own failure. Why blame those who scorn them? Renown was within reach, so scorn for missing it is certain.
couplets.sensitive: tells the reviled to blame themselves

couplets.plain: They say it is a disgrace for everyone on earth not to gain the legacy called renown.
couplets.pm: If people could gain the legacy called renown and don’t, the good say that this alone is their disgrace, for anyone on earth. It is called a legacy because it stays undying when its maker dies. No other fault is needed for scorn.

links.quote: not to gain the legacy called renown

couplets.plain: Land that carries a body without renown will lose its rich, faultless yield.
couplets.pm: Land that carries a body without renown falls off in its rich, faultless yield. It is called a body because though it has life, no use comes of it, and it is a burden on the land. The yield fails from the land’s disgust at bearing a sinful body.

links.reason: Even a land’s rich yield shrinks under a body with no renown.

links.quote: Land that carries a body without renown
links.reason: The ground is shown losing its yield under the weight of those it carries.

couplets.plain: Only those who live free of disgrace are alive. Those who live without renown are not alive.
couplets.pm: Only those who live with no disgrace are truly alive. Those who live with no renown are dead. To be free of disgrace is to have the legacy of renown, and to lack renown is to have disgrace. So household life brings renown in this world and pleasure in the world of the gods.
couplets.sensitive: Says those without glory are as good as dead.

links.quote: Only those who live free of disgrace are alive
Those who live without renown are not alive
